context: Ran a 10-agent ultracode comparison of zilliztech/memsearch vs Twining (6 readers, 1 synthesis, 3 adversarial verifiers; ~976k tokens). Verdict: complementary tools — memsearch wins retrieval/capture, Twining wins decisions/coordination. Several verified findings are actionable for Twining.
rationale: the verify pass caught 8 wrong/overstated claims in the synthesis, including two that would have flattered Twining (inert-graph premise, 'guarantees capture' framing)
summary: Chose to run the memsearch comparison as a workflow with adversarial verification (memsearch-accuracy, twining-accuracy, fairness lenses) over a single-context read
